rationale: sweep Aug4: The Darwin Test squad (Jul 27) leaves out Litton Das (injured, first Test only) and Mahmudul Hasan Joy, and recalls Soumya Sarkar; the batters are Shanto, Shadman, Tanzid, Mominul, Mushfiqur, Amite, Jaker and Mehidy. Bangladesh climbed to 4th in the WTC after beating Pakistan at home (ICC, Jul 31). The resolution date is Aug 14, so effectively only days 1-2 of the first Test (Aug 13-17) count.

sweep Aug4: Both clubs drew 2-2 on Aug 1 (Nashville at DC United, Miami v Columbus), leaving Nashville on 40 pts (12W) and Miami on 38 (11W), each after 18 games. Each has only two MLS games before the deadline: Nashville v Miami at Geodis Park on Aug 15, then Nashville at NY Red Bulls and Miami at Philadelphia on Aug 19. Miami have Messi back (Aug 1) and signed Casemiro; scenario math gives Miami about 30%.

sweep Aug4: No deadly Indonesian quake has been reported since Jul 21; the Jul 22 M5.7 near Langsa (Aceh/N. Sumatra) and the Jul 31 M5.2 in the Ceram Sea had no reported casualties. The Jun 16 Sigi M6.7 (Central Sulawesi, 3 deaths per BNPB) is still the deadliest, with about 13 days left.

sweep Aug4: Gretchen Walsh set the 50 free world record (23.55, Jun 28) and won US Nationals in 23.60 (Aug 1) in the same Irvine pool that hosts Pan Pacs (Aug 12-15), 0.45s ahead of the next best. Kate Douglass (23.59 in June) has ruled out swimming all three of her Aug 15 events (200 IM, 50 free, 200 breast), and Swimming World says Walsh is 'favored regardless'. Reigning world champion Meg Harris won the CWG 50/100 free (late July).

sweep Aug4: The UFC 330 card is intact as of Aug 4, with Dern -225 and Robertson +190 at BetOnline (about 67% for Dern no-vig, up from about 62% at the open). Dern also keeps the belt if the bout falls through.

sweep Aug4: Djokovic (world No. 5) confirmed Cincinnati (Aug 13-23) on Jul 30 after withdrawing from Montreal. The field includes Sinner, Zverev (No. 2, RG champion) and Alcaraz (wrist, unplayed since April), and Auger-Aliassime is No. 2 seed in Montreal (likely No. 4). Djokovic will probably be seeded 4-5, so a top-4 seed can come in the QF. The draw is around Aug 11, and early-round losers remain unpredictable.

sweep Aug4: Pallister won 400/800/1500 at the Commonwealth Games (800 in 8:11.12 on Jul 28 after going out under WR pace; 400 in 3:59.56), so she is in solid but not breakthrough form. Ledecky skipped US Nationals to prepare for Pan Pacs and has an unbeaten major-meet 800 record (8:08.57 in March). The women's 800 is on Aug 15, the same day as the 200 IM, and McIntosh dropped the 800 at Canadian trials and skipped Glasgow, so she is unlikely to swim it.

sweep Aug4: The UFC 330 main event is intact, with Makhachev -335 and Garry +275 at BetOnline on Aug 4 (about 74% no-vig, slightly down from -365/+300 at the open). There is a small risk of an opponent change.

sweep Aug4: The Shield is on Aug 16 at Cardiff's Principality Stadium. Arsenal are 2025-26 PL champions with squad continuity. City are under new manager Maresca, have lost Stones, Bernardo and Ake, have Rodri out after back surgery, and drew 1-1 with Inter before losing the shootout on Aug 1. Previews give Arsenal a slight edge.

sweep Aug4: Hosts Morocco topped Group A unbeaten (7 pts, Aug 3) and face Group B runners-up South Africa in the QF (Aug 8); Algeria play Ivory Coast. Nigeria lost 3-2 to Malawi (Jul 28) and beat Zambia 1-0 with 10 players (Aug 1); Group C is Malawi 6, Nigeria 3, Zambia 3, with Nigeria v Egypt and Malawi v Zambia on Aug 5. Cameroon beat Ghana 1-0 to qualify from Group D. Final is Aug 16.

sweep Aug4: McIlroy (world No. 2) is set to skip the St Jude and BMW and go straight to the Tour Championship (Irish Times, Jul 20), so he is dropped. FedEx standings (Aug 3) are Scheffler 1st, Fitzpatrick 2nd and Young 3rd (world No. 3). Scheffler was 2nd at the 3M Open (Jul 26) and Schauffele 2nd at the Rocket Classic (Aug 2).

sweep Aug4: Pool D in Amstelveen runs Aug 15 (India v Wales, England v Pakistan), Aug 17 (India v England) and Aug 19 (England v Wales, Pakistan v India). Both sides struggled in the Pro League (India 8th of 9; England narrowly avoided relegation) and drew 2-2 on Jun 25, so this is close to a coin flip decided by India v England or goal difference.

sweep Aug4: The JRI preview (Jul 31) sees Q2 GDP +0.4% q/q, with external demand +0.3pp against domestic demand of about +0.1pp, because national oil reserve drawdowns cut public inventories by 0.2pp. Daiwa (Jul 31) sees +0.7% q/q, driven by consumption and an import drop from the Hormuz closure. June crude import volumes were still -13.7% y/y.
